title: College Basketball
description:
IU-Indianapolis at Penn State
The Penn State Nittany Lions (4-1) host the IU Indianapolis Jaguars (3-1) at Bryce Jordan Center. IU Indianapolis fell 79-75 and relies on Gus Etchison, while Penn State seeks to make it three straight following an 86-52 win over New Haven.

title: College Basketball
description:
South Dakota at Nebraska
The South Dakota Coyotes (2-4) travel to Lincoln to face the No. 25 Nebraska Cornhuskers (4-0) at Pinnacle Bank Arena. South Dakota enters after a 81-57 victory over Doane, while Nebraska is on a four-game win streak and looks to Pryce Sandfort.

title: College Basketball
description:
Cal State Fullerton at UCLA
The Cal State Fullerton Titans play the UCLA Bruins at Pauley Pavilion for an NCAA matchup. Cal State Fullerton sits at 2-1 and beat Lincoln (CA) 101-71 behind Joshua Ward, while UCLA relies on Nikola Kusturica who leads the team in points per game.

title: College Basketball
description:
Maryland-Baltimore County at Ohio State
The Ohio State Buckeyes host the UMBC Retrievers at Schottenstein Center in an NCAA basketball game. Devin Ceaser leads UMBC with over 15 points per game, while John Mobley Jr. leads Ohio State with over 18 points and nearly five assists per game.

title: College Basketball
description:
Oregon State vs. Oregon
The Oregon Ducks host the Oregon State Beavers at Moda Center in Portland in an NCAA basketball matchup. Oregon State looks to Daniel Freitag who leads with over 17 points, while Oregon relies on Wei Lin who leads the team in points and assists.

title: College Basketball
description:
Tarleton State at USC
The USC Trojans host the Tarleton State Texans in an NCAA men's basketball regular-season game at Galen Center. USC enters this matchup with a four-game win streak, while Tarleton State relies on Leroy Kelly IV who leads in points and rebounds.

title: College Basketball
description:
Oakland at Purdue
The Oakland Golden Grizzlies take on the Purdue Boilermakers at Mackey Arena in West Lafayette. Oakland beat Northern Iowa 80-76 on Nov. 14 and looks to Nassim Mashhour, while Purdue beat Ohio 80-62 on Nov. 13 and looks to Daniel Jacobsen.

title: College Basketball
description:
Eastern Illinois at Illinois
The No. 10 Illinois Fighting Illini host the Eastern Illinois Panthers at State Farm Center in Champaign. Illinois beat Sam Houston 108-86 on Nov. 13 behind Tomislav Ivisic. Eastern Illinois fell to Purdue Fort Wayne 86-74 on Nov. 15.

title: Women's College Basketball
description:
Baylor vs. USC
The Baylor Bears face the No. 4 USC Trojans in NCAA Division I Women's Basketball game at Intuit Dome. Baylor defeated East Texas A&M 100-66 on November 15 alongside Taliah Scott, while USC lost 89-85 to South Carolina on November 15.
